statement.zh: 整合期政治形态是否最好标为领土「帝国」、城市—区域网络或「国家」仍属开放争议；事实栏只描述城市与标准化证据。
statement.en: Whether the Integration Era is best labeled territorial “empire,” city–regional network, or “state” remains open; fact columns describe urbanism and standardization only.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
